Dear Students, Parents, and Esteemed Visitors,

It is with great pride and pleasure that I extend my warm greetings to you on behalf of Green Peace Lincoln College.

Our vision has always been to establish an institution that not only imparts quality education but also nurtures responsible, confident, and capable individuals. We are committed to creating a progressive learning environment where students are encouraged to explore their potential, think independently, and develop a strong sense of purpose.

At Green Peace Lincoln College, we emphasize values-driven education combined with modern teaching methodologies. We believe that today’s students are tomorrow’s leaders, and it is our responsibility to guide them with knowledge, integrity, and innovation so they can contribute meaningfully to society.

I sincerely thank all our students, parents, faculty, and well-wishers for their continuous trust and support. Together, we will continue to strive for excellence and achieve new milestones.

With best wishes for your success and bright future.

Warm regards,
Keshav Khadka
Director

Dear Students, Parents, and Well-Wishers,

It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Green Peace Lincoln College—an institution committed to academic excellence, holistic development, and the nurturing of responsible global citizens.

At our college, we believe that education is not merely about acquiring knowledge, but about shaping character, building confidence, and inspiring innovation. We strive to create a learning environment that encourages curiosity, critical thinking, and creativity, ensuring that our students are well-prepared to meet the challenges of a rapidly changing world.

Our dedicated faculty members work tirelessly to provide quality education while fostering values such as discipline, integrity, and respect. We emphasize both academic and extracurricular activities, recognizing that true education lies in the balanced development of mind, body, and spirit.

As we continue our journey, we remain committed to empowering our students with the skills, knowledge, and values needed to succeed and contribute positively to society. Together, let us build a future filled with opportunities, growth, and success.

Thank you for being a part of our institution.

Warm regards,

About Green Peace Lincoln College

Students usually want to know three things first: what kind of institution they are joining, what academic opportunities they will receive, and whether the environment will support their long-term growth. This page is built to answer those questions clearly.

The main content below can be updated from the dashboard and should ideally include the college history, mission, affiliation, academic vision, student support, campus values, and future opportunities.

About

A student-centred institution focused on career-ready education.

Green Peace Lincoln College (GPLC) is promoted and managed by the ISMT Group, International School of Management and Technology. ISMT was established to provide internationally recognised qualifications in partnership with reputed universities. GPLC, in partnership with Lincoln University College, offers industry-relevant BIT, BBA and MBA programmes. The College is committed to improving higher education in Nepal by offering quality, industry-focused education that is accessible to motivated students who want to build successful careers.

Following the vision of the ISMT Group, Green Peace Lincoln College provides a supportive and engaging learning environment where students are encouraged to develop their knowledge, skills, and confidence. The College uses modern teaching methods, interactive classroom activities, and personalised academic support to help every student achieve their full potential.

The College believes that higher education is not only about gaining academic knowledge but also about developing the practical skills required for career development and professional success. Students learn by applying theory to real-life situations through projects, case studies, group discussions, presentations, research, internships, and other practical learning activities. These experiences strengthen their critical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, and professional competence.

In addition to academic studies, the College offers a wide range of co-curricular and extracurricular activities that help students develop communication, teamwork, leadership, management, and strategic skills. These opportunities prepare graduates to meet the expectations of employers and contribute positively to their professions and society.

Mission & Vision

What guides our academic purpose.

Mission
How we serve students and society

Committed to providing quality higher education that nurtures curiosity, critical thinking, and effective communication. Through innovative teaching, competence-based learning, entrepreneurial mindsets, and ethical practices, we empower students to achieve academic excellence, professional competence, and personal growth that eventually contribute to local and global communities.

Vision
The future we are building toward

To be a leading and respected academic institution that fosters curiosity, effective communication, innovation, entrepreneurship, ethical values, and competence-based learning, empowering students to develop integrated personalities and become responsible contributors to their communities and society.

Goals

What Green Peace Lincoln College aims to achieve.

  • 01 To foster curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, and lifelong learning by providing engaging learning experiences that encourage students to explore, innovate, and solve real-world problems.
  • 02 To strengthen students' communication, leadership, and professional skills so that they can perform confidently and responsibly in diverse business, professional, and social environments.
  • 03 To promote entrepreneurship, innovation, and a self-correcting approach by equipping students with the knowledge, skills, and mindset required to create opportunities and adapt to a rapidly changing world.
  • 04 To enhance graduates' employability and global competitiveness through industry-relevant curricula, practical learning opportunities, and the development of transferable skills.
  • 05 To build strong partnerships with industry, professional bodies, and academic institutions to enrich learning, research, and career opportunities for its graduates.

Values

The principles that define our learning culture.

Student-centred education
Continuous enhancement and self-correcting approach
Innovation and employability
Integrity and professionalism
Sustainability and social responsibility

About Lincoln University College

A globally focused university partner in Malaysia.

Lincoln University College (LUC), Malaysia, is a leading university established in 2002. Located in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, the University College is approved by the Ministry of Higher Education (MOHE), Malaysia, and its programmes are accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA). LUC is committed to providing high-quality, student-centred education that prepares graduates for successful careers in an increasingly globalized world.

Lincoln University College offers a broad range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in areas including Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Hospitality and Tourism, Health Sciences, Education, and Social Sciences.

Its curriculum combines academic knowledge with practical learning, industry engagement, research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and the responsible use of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence. This approach enables students to develop the professional knowledge, technical skills, and leadership qualities required in today's competitive workplace.

The University's emphasis on innovation, sustainability, lifelong learning, and global citizenship equips graduates to contribute meaningfully to their professions and society.

Why Choose Green Peace Lincoln College?

Designed for academic growth, professional readiness, and global opportunity.

Internationally Recognised Qualifications

Green Peace Lincoln College, managed by the ISMT Group, offers internationally recognised qualifications in partnership with reputable universities. These qualifications are respected by employers and higher education institutions, providing graduates with opportunities for employment and further study in Nepal and around the world.

Industry-Relevant BIT, BBA and MBA Programmes

The BIT, BBA and MBA programmes are designed to meet the needs of today's technology and business sectors. Students develop the knowledge, practical skills, and professional competencies required by employers through case studies, projects, presentations, research, and real-world problem-solving activities.

Entrepreneurship and Innovation

The College encourages students to think creatively, identify new opportunities, and develop innovative solutions. Whether they plan to start their own business or build successful careers in established organisations, students gain the confidence and entrepreneurial mindset needed to succeed in a changing world.

Practical Learning for Career Success

Learning goes beyond the classroom. Students apply theoretical concepts in practical situations through project-based learning, internships, industry interactions, and collaborative activities. This approach builds confidence and prepares graduates to perform effectively in professional environments.

Experienced Faculty and Personalised Student Support

Students are taught by qualified academics and experienced industry professionals who combine academic knowledge with practical experience. Smart class sizes, interactive teaching methods, and personalised academic support create a learning environment where every student can achieve their full potential.

Strong Focus on Employability

The College, through different curricular activities, helps students develop the skills that contemporary industries value most, including communication, leadership, teamwork, critical thinking, digital literacy, and problem-solving. Students also receive guidance and opportunities to strengthen their career readiness and professional networks.

Modern Learning Environment

The College provides a supportive and engaging learning environment with modern teaching practices, well-equipped facilities, and a strong commitment to student success. Students are encouraged to participate actively in both academic and co-curricular activities that support their personal and professional development.

Managed and Promoted by ISMT College

GPLC is managed and promoted by ISMT Group, bringing an established academic vision, international partnerships, and a student-focused approach to higher education in Nepal.

Program Overview

The Master of Business Administration (MBA) program at Green Peace Lincoln College, affiliated with Lincoln University, prepares students for leadership roles in a global business environment. The program emphasizes real-world application, strategic thinking, and advanced managerial skills to meet modern market demands.

Why Choose Our MBA?

  • Global business perspective

  • Experienced faculty & mentors
  • Career advancement opportunities

Career Opportunities

  • Entrepreneur
  • Business Consultant

Policy Details

Privacy Policy

Green Peace Lincoln College
gplc.edu.np
Last Updated: April 11, 2026

Welcome to Green Peace Lincoln College (GPLC). Your trust matters deeply to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, safeguard, and respect your personal information when you visit our website gplc.edu.np or engage with our academic programs, admissions, and community services.

📑 Quick Navigation

  1. Information We Collect
  2. How We Use Your Information
  3. Cookies & Tracking Technologies
  4. Data Protection & Security
  5. Third-Party Sharing
  6. Your Rights & Choices
  7. Student & Academic Records
  8. Contact Us

📋 1. Information We Collect

Personal Information You Provide:

  • Name, email address, phone number, and mailing address
  • Academic records, transcripts, and enrollment details
  • Identification documents (for admission & verification)
  • Payment information (processed securely via PCI-compliant gateways)
  • Messages, inquiries, and communication history with GPLC

Automatically Collected Information:

  • IP address, browser type, device information
  • Pages visited, time spent, and referral URLs
  • Cookie identifiers and analytics data (see Section 3)

✨ 2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information responsibly to:

  • ✅ Process admissions, enrollments, and academic services
  • ✅ Communicate updates, announcements, and important notices
  • ✅ Personalize your experience on gplc.edu.np
  • ✅ Improve our website, programs, and student support
  • ✅ Ensure campus safety, security, and regulatory compliance
  • ✅ Conduct research and institutional planning (anonymized/aggregated)

🍪 3. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies to enhance functionality and user experience:

Essential Cookies
Required for website operation (login, forms, security)
Analytics Cookies
Help us understand traffic and improve content (Google Analytics)
Preference Cookies
Remember your language, theme, and accessibility settings

🔹 You can manage cookie preferences via your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect website functionality.

🛡️ 4. Data Protection & Security

Green Peace Lincoln College implements industry-standard safeguards:

  • 🔐 SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmissions
  • 🗄️ Secure, access-controlled databases with regular audits
  • 👥 Staff training on data privacy and confidentiality
  • 🔄 Regular security updates and vulnerability assessments
  • 📜 Compliance with Nepal's Electronic Transactions Act & global best practices

*While we strive for maximum security, no digital transmission is 100% immune to risks. We commit to prompt notification in case of any verified data incident.

🤝 5. Third-Party Sharing

We do not sell your personal data. Limited sharing occurs only when necessary:

  • 🎓 Accreditation bodies & government education authorities (as legally required)
  • 💳 Secure payment processors for fee transactions (PCI-DSS compliant)
  • ☁️ Trusted service providers (hosting, email, analytics) under strict confidentiality agreements
  • ⚖️ Legal authorities when compelled by valid court order or statutory obligation

All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data and use it solely for specified purposes.

⚖️ 6. Your Rights & Choices

You have the right to:

👁️ Access
Request a copy of your data
✏️ Correct
Update inaccurate information
🗑️ Delete
Request data erasure (where applicable)
🚫 Opt-Out
Unsubscribe from marketing communications

To exercise your rights, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@gplc.edu.np

🎓 7. Student & Academic Records

Academic records are maintained with heightened confidentiality:

  • 📚 Grades, attendance, and assessments are accessible only to authorized faculty & administration
  • 🔐 Student portals use multi-factor authentication and session timeouts
  • 📄 Transcripts and certificates are issued only upon verified student request
  • ♻️ Records are retained per Nepal's education regulations and securely archived/disposed thereafter

ℹ️ Note: Parents/guardians of minor students may access records in accordance with institutional policy and applicable law.
